svg.title: IS-02: a person steps out from behind the rack end, unseen until 0.5 m ahead, looping
svg.desc: Looping top view of IS-02: a person steps out from behind the rack end, unseen until 0.5 m ahead. A fixed crop of the warehouse plan with the robot, its field where one applies, the person on their path at walking speed, the events lighting up below, a cursor on a time strip and a plot of the distance between the person and the robot, which reaches 0.33 m in the planning case.

svg.text: The person is briefed staff, closest 0.5 m if nothing stops the robot (WP-C-06 §2). A viewer that shows the SVG as a still shows t = -0.5 s.
